==Notes==
* This skill will still deal damage if an enchantment or hex is [[Renewal|renewed]], whether by being recast or by reapplying itself (such as with [[Critical Defenses]], [[Lyssa's Aura]], [[Kinetic Armor]], or [[Recurring Insecurity]]).
* Damage occurs when the enemy gains the effect of an enchantment or hex. Accordingly:
** [[Enchantment_spell#Characteristics|Using an enchantment spell on an enemy]] will not trigger Soul Barbs damage.
** Spells that only count as hexes under certain conditions, such as [[Lightning Strike]] or [[Ash Blast]], will not trigger Soul Barbs damage unless their condition is met.

== Trivia ==
* This skill has a unique casting symbol which looks like the mark on the [[skill icon]].
